transitions.label: Session start in the tower
transitions.evidence: Session YAML anchors April 15. u0131–u0137 confirms it is still night with the Fox and Hunter overhead; u0002 refers back to entering the storm earlier that afternoon.

transitions.label: About twenty minutes of searching
transitions.time: night; about twenty minutes into the search
transitions.evidence: u0492: “about 20 minutes so far.” This is an elapsed-time cue, not a new date.

transitions.label: Parallel searches and reading completed
transitions.evidence: u0720 describes 15–20 minutes of Delwath’s reading; u0772–u0777 reconvenes the party after about twenty minutes. Parallel activity is not added as separate elapsed intervals.

transitions.label: Ten-minute fey-sight examination
transitions.evidence: u0934 spends ten minutes to inspect the room with fey sight; u0940–u0965 gives the result.

transitions.label: One-minute opening beneath the door
transitions.evidence: u1101–u1103 establishes a one-minute duration; u1112 and u1120–u1122 resolves extraction before the spell ends.

transitions.label: Lucidity fails; departure becomes urgent
transitions.evidence: u1847 the Fox and Hunter starts fading; u1850 Kenzo warns it is time to go. No rest was completed and the earlier waiting has no exact duration.

transitions.label: Night travel into the storm
transitions.evidence: u1977 explicitly says it is night. u2018–u2023 describes disorientation and uncertainty about minutes versus hours, not a definite multi-day jump.

transitions.label: Emergence at dawn on the next day
transitions.evidence: u2024 explicitly emerges into morning, reinforced by dawn at u2040–u2047. u2048–u2053 expresses subjective uncertainty; Vola’s answer “just a day” at u2161–u2162 supports the next morning and matches drEnd.

transitions.label: Return to camp after circling the storm
transitions.evidence: u2070–u2072 estimates a walk of a few hours; u2143–u2155 narrates the return and Vola packing breakfast. u2431–u2432 still calls it a clear morning and a young day. The private conversation at u2201–u2204 is explicitly retroactively placed during this approach.
